scope_items.item: A unit test checks that every Wasabi boto3 client created through clients.py has response_checksum_validation='when_required' and request_checksum_calculation='when_required'.
A regression test with a mocked GetObject that copies Wasabi's response for an appended object shows object_get_text returning the original text followed by the appended text, with no exception.
scope_items.evidence: tests/tools/test_objects_read.py:188-250 (fails with FlexibleChecksumError on main's clients.py, passes on branch)

scope_items.item: object_get_text on a plain, never-appended object still returns the right text, and the existing object put/get tests still pass.
scope_items.evidence: full suite: 1257 passed, 11 deselected; ruff check/format clean

scope_items.item: If botocore raises an error, object_get_text returns a clear tool error and no unhandled exception reaches the MCP client.
scope_items.evidence: src/wasabi_mcp/tools/objects_read.py:305-319 covers body-read errors (tests/tools/test_objects_read.py:266-290), but the new catch-all also wraps _s3()'s own ToolRefused from GetBucketLocation, replacing a clear error with 'GetObject failed while reading the object body: ToolRefused.'

scope_items.item: A live-marked test in tests/live/ runs object_put_text, object_append, then object_get_text, and is skipped when WASABI_LIVE is not set to 1.
Scope: shared BASE_CONFIG in clients.py merged into S3 config and used for IAM/STS
Scope: techContext note on Wasabi flexible checksums

regressions.description: object_get_text on a missing/inaccessible bucket used to return 'GetBucketLocation failed: NoSuchBucket: ...'; the new `except Exception` around `_s3(ctx, bucket, region)` now catches that ToolRefused and returns the uninformative 'GetObject failed while reading the object body: ToolRefused.' (reproduced against moto).

edge_cases.description: Region lookup (GetBucketLocation) failure inside the widened try block keeps its clear error
BotoCoreError (FlexibleChecksumError) on body read becomes a tool error
Unexpected AttributeError on body read becomes a tool error without leaking secrets
Cached clients: before-send hooks added after first client use
